title: What Is Gallbladder Surgery?
description: What gallbladder surgery (cholecystectomy) is, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: Gallbladder surgery (cholecystectomy) removes the gallbladder, usually because of stones that cause colic or inflammation. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
Gallbladder surgery (cholecystectomy) removes the gallbladder, usually because of stones that cause colic or inflammation.

How is it done?

It is almost always performed laparoscopically: 3–4 small incisions, a camera and removal of the gallbladder.

When is it indicated?

People with symptomatic stones, cholecystitis or polyps that carry risk. The surgeon decides.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team across different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

faqs.a: The surgeon, after an evaluation with tests.

title: Risks and Complications of Gallbladder Surgery

tldr: Like any surgery, gallbladder surgery has risks: bleeding, infection, bile duct injury (uncommon) and conversion to open surgery. They are uncommon and are reduced with proper evaluation, careful technique and follow-up. The surgeon explains them during the consultation.
bodyHtml:
Learning about the risks of gallbladder surgery is part of a responsible decision.

faqs.a: It is a common procedure; safety depends on the evaluation, the technique and the follow-up.
